THAKUR COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNO.description: TCET (Thakur College of Engineering and Technology) was established in the year 2001 in Mumbai, Maharashtra. The college is affiliated to the University of Mumbai and has been granted conferred Autonomous Status by University Grant Commission (UGC) till 2029. The college has also been awarded Grade “A” by NAAC till 2022.  At present, TCET is offering 12 UG (8 in Engineering, 3 in Technology, and 1 in Vocational course), 3 PG and 3 Ph.D. (Tech.) programs. Admissions at the TCET are done on the basis of both merit and entrance test. Candidates are required to appear in the MH-CET entrance exam in order to get admission to the B.E, while M.E admissions are based on the GATE scores. Check TCET Admission 2024  Thakur College of Engineering and Technology also provides impressive placement and internship opportunities to its students. More than 90 companies are visiting the campus every year to recruit students. The highest salary package stood at INR 7 LPA, while the average CTC offered is INR 3.35 LPA. Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Accenture, i-Gate, and Tech Mahindra are some of the top recruiters associated with TCET.
THAKUR COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNO.name: Thakur College of Engineering and Technology -(TCET),Kandivali
